## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-6001 by identifying that the search-api HPA failure was caused by the log-forwarder sidecar container lacking CPU resource requests. When the 4.8.0 deployment was released with the fluent-bit log-forwarder container added, it was configured without any resource requests. This breaks HPA's ability to calculate CPU utilization metrics for the entire pod, causing the "cpu <unknown>" error.

The fix is to add appropriate CPU and memory resource requests to the log-forwarder container in the Deployment specification, after which the HPA will resume normal scaling behavior.
